Terminal record: all fourteen phases closed, inherited API, six further elaboration traps, and what is deliberately absent.

partial_progress.details: All fourteen plan phases closed. Phase 10 landed the branching TaskModel and T1 truth_iff_mem; Phase 11 the five-component Certifies, decidableCertifies and a second producer for the unchanged WitnessFamily.Refutes; Phase 12 WitnessFamily.toSharing with all four condition reductions as iffs; Phase 13 the frame isomorphism and truth transport; Phase 14 the documentation, the in-repo (C3) correction, and the full gate set.

completion_data.completion_summary: Added a state-sharing (branching) witness device alongside the shipped deterministic bi-lasso device as FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/WitnessFamily/Sharing/, closing all fourteen plan phases. The branching frame's histories are characterized by total_eq_thread (replacing ShiftSet.total_eq_orbit, which holds only for a functional task relation), the revised conditions (C0) AtomCoherent, (C1') LocalCoherentShare and (C2') ThreadFulfilling are all decidable, and refutes_of_certifies lands in the unchanged WitnessFamily.Refutes so the two devices are two producers for one interface. The deterministic device is recovered as the diagonal instance WitnessFamily.toSharing, with each branching condition proved equivalent to its deterministic counterpart and the two frames exhibited as isomorphic with truth transported across; ShiftSet.lean and the five deterministic WitnessFamily modules are byte-identical.

metadata.compliance_note: All fifteen of the plan's pinned Goals are present and were confirmed by a `#print axioms` run on their fully qualified names (fifteen reports, each exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], zero sorryAx) -- strictly stronger evidence than the contract's bare-name grep, which extracts only the two dot-free names `SharingWitnessFamily` and `share` from the plan's Goals block and finds both.
